changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment:
Who accepted or refused the corrective work on re-inspection.
The trail already recorded verified_at and the verification remarks but not the person, so a report could say the work had been verified without saying by whom. That is the one thing sign-off is for: the discipline check on closing a non-conformance exists precisely because it matters which qualified person accepted it, and the record has to carry that name.
Nullable and not backfilled. Reports verified before this column existed have no such record to recover, and inventing one would be worse than a report that shows the gap.
